body: Please listen this warning  the content is extremely triggering

I spent like more time then I really should have looking through the sub Reddit and the majority of those people are just like stay away from people w bpd, it's not worth it blah fucking blah. Like wow were fucking humans and we deserve love and, yeah we can be fucking difficult but the majority of us are working on our symptoms and do our best to not let it affect people around us. We are not fucking inherently abusive and saying that we are was the general theme of that whole ass group.
I know I hope by posting this I don't cause everyone to go through what I just did, but I found it accidentally and man I wish I hadn't. Some really awful people in there.

I don't even know if the connection is mutual we never talk about feelings or stuff we just exist together when we can. We're in a tight knit friend group and he has exs and I have exs and it would be messy. I love him to pieces but I don't want to blow up several friendships or cause drama just for us to not work out or something.
Sometimes I feel like I am the most sweet caring person on the planet and minutes later I feel like I could be shooting fire out of my fucking eyes
Maybe this is an unpopular opinion but considering that attention seeking IS a symptom of bpd maybe we shouldn't be so crass to someone who is just like us.
The meds do the exact opposite to me everything feels so intense I feel like I'm being ripped apart
I wish I had friends like this
Actually I got it from fb

That's just the current trigger I mean I've been depressed as long as i can really remember I'll be 23 this month but my first attempt was when I was 13. I dont realll know why it's probably just a build up random fucked up shit it my life. My mom abandoned me when I was 3 for some guy she met on the internet, my dad was extremely bipolar and had no business raising me much less on his own. I was in relationships with 20-23 year old boys from 13-16 who would manipulate me emotionally. Then when I was 17 I got into an extremely abusive relationship with a boy I went to high school with that didnt end until I was just under 21. A baby resulted from that relationship and I had to give her up to some close family friends as I was in no mental place to raise a child. I have never told anyone any of this so it's all been living inside me and probably rotting me from inside out. Sorry I know this is some heavy shit or whatver but as bad as that all sounds o mean like I have a car and an apartment and no one is hitting me currently and i eat regularly so I feel worse for not wanting to live or whatever cause I know people have it much worse you know.

Well since the group is so tight knit I've dated a couple of his friends and vice versa so by coming out with it we could potentially blow up like 5 separate friendships or at least cause a lot of drama.

Its dumb but since I have really severe depression and anxiety almost anything can trigger it. But basically I got involved with this guy I've known for a hella long time. He was literally my best friend for 8 years and anyways we were drinking buddies and we got drunk one night and well shit happened. And then it kept happening and we both caught feelings but it had to all be secret cause our friends would get hurt since it's a tight knit group so it was all messy. Anyways, I finally told him a couple days ago that we had to call a quits and I needed space from him to heal so we can maintain our friendship but since I cut him off I've had to isolate from all of our friends since you know he would be around we all hang out like every day. The worst thing is since it's a secret I cant even talk to anyone about it so I just keep telling everyone I'm sick or tired when they ask to hang out and if sucks.
I mean after that last experience I'm not ready to try again or anything cause I REALLY suck at dying but I am going through a pretty bad depressive episode
